lines.style: First-person survivor, panting mid-struggle, short sharp bursts, the last word ugly and raw.

lines.text: We ran till the bridge was behind us.
lines.style: Narrating out of breath, running, fast and ragged.

lines.text: Three lines. Not deep. They didn't need to *be.*
lines.style: Narrating, very quiet and flat, numb with dread, a long pause before the last word.

lines.text: If I turn... don't wait. *Promise* me.
lines.style: A young man speaking softly to a friend, steady and serious, hiding his fear, begging on the last two words.
Teenage girl, voice shaking, angry to keep from crying, barely a whisper.

lines.text: That night, while she slept, I wrote her a *note.*
lines.style: Narrating, hushed and tender, like a secret.

lines.text: Morning came. My eyes were still *mine.*
lines.style: Narrating, exhausted relief, a shaky breath of a laugh on the last word.
Teenage girl, disbelieving, then breaking into joy on the dog's name.

lines.text: Then I coughed. And I didn't tell her what came *up.*
lines.style: Narrating, quiet and hollow, guilty, slow, the last word barely said.

music.style: Cinematic survival score. Opens in frantic panic with pounding drums and racing strings, then drops to a hushed night: a lonely music-box piano and a soft low drone, fragile and tender. A warm hopeful dawn swell with gentle strings and a rising major chord for the reunion, then it curdles into a dark, detuned, sick low tone at the very end. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
